items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My children, I have two children by my former wife, her name was Lola.

ctx.x: My children, I have two children by my former wife, her name was Lola. My children, my daughter is Milan Alexandria Owens. She was born…the 23rd of March, 1967. My son, his name is Ayan Nyerere Owens. He was named after Julius Nyerere. And he was born the 18th of May 1972.
Okay, very good. Let’s begin with the Bronx. Let’s begin with your parents. Could you state your parents’ names and where they were from?
